### [A Confidence Estimation Framework for Skin & Product Audits](https://qurtis.tech/research/papers/confidence-estimation-framework)

::: {.item-meta}
June 18, 2026 · Qutis AI Research Team · Published
:::

Automated audits must know when they are uncertain. This paper describes how Qutis converts model token log-probabilities into per-observation confidence scores, aggregates them across multiple audit concerns, and routes low-confidence cases to qualified human review.
